question: According to the passages, does adding more distractor text always leave answer correctness unchanged while harming evidence coverage?
required_claim: Not always; sometimes correctness also drops, but coverage can fall even when the answer still looks correct.

passages.text: A mural was painted on the east wall of the student union.

Distractor note R: In controlled prompts, increasing irrelevant but plausible text often reduced how many gold evidence items were cited, even when the final sentence still matched a simple answer key.
The bike share station reported three docks offline.
A nutrition flyer listed campus vegan meal options.
Distractor note S: In some items, heavy distractors also flipped the answer itself, so correctness was not always stable when coverage fell.
The astronomy club announced a cloudy-night cancellation.
A maintenance request closed the south stairwell overnight.
